_about: Completion offer for wehale.io/breathe, in the shape proposed for GET /public/web-offer (app repo docs/marketing/2026-q4-paid/web-session/OFFER-CONFIG.md). 'standard' is today's truth for everyone and is what the end screen shows whenever no offer is live, the read fails, or it takes over 1.5 s. 'offer' is shown only while status is 'live'; the site then draws one arm per visitor by weight, stores it in localStorage and carries a token in the OneLink. The Swedish lines are drafts for Isak to check. Keep the variant 'draft' until the owner of main confirms the server grants it. start_*/progress_*: shown only in the landing variants a, b and c, only to the arm that has them, only while the offer is live (the arm is then drawn on landing, not at the end screen).
